corrected_content.problem:
$$
\displaystyle \mathbf{f}(x, t) = ⟨x, \underline{\phantom{xxxx}}, 2\sec t⟩, t ∈ (-\frac{π}{2}, \frac{π}{2})
$$

The vector-valued function $\mathbf{f}(x,t)$ above parametrizes one sheet of the hyperbolic cylinder defined in Cartesian coordinates as $3z^{2} - 4y^{2} = 12$ for $z \ge 2$. What is the second component of $\mathbf{f}$?
corrected_content.worked_solution: Set $y=\sqrt3\tan t$ and $z=2\sec t$. Then $$3z^2-4y^2=12\sec^2t-12\tan^2t=12.$$ On $-\pi/2<t<\pi/2$, $\sec t\ge1$, so $z\ge2$. Thus the required second component is $\sqrt3\tan t$.
